answer: Require a 340-unit escrowed bond and a twenty-one epoch probation per agent identity. Each round it solves one random task and collects four endorsements from reviewers whose recent partners do not intersect; reused proofs, duplicated sentences, or same-window bursts freeze the bond for eight rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 340 units per alias and replays twenty-one rounds, while a lagoon of matching traces betrays the cluster, signal rotation spreads work, and juniper-sealed receipts certify reviews.
